title: Add Unified Request Body Parser Middleware
description: Introduce a core middleware that automatically parses JSON, URL‑encoded, and multipart/form‑data request bodies with configurable size limits and content‑type detection. This eliminates the need for external parsers, reduces boilerplate, and improves security by enforcing payload limits.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify req.body contains the correct object
Parse a URL‑encoded payload and verify req.body matches the key/value pairs
Reject a payload exceeding the configured size limit with a 413 response
Gracefully handle malformed JSON with a 400 error
Parse a multipart/form‑data request with a file field and ensure the file buffer is attached to req.files
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, middleware can be enabled via app.use(bodyParser({limit: '1mb'})), and error responses follow the framework's standard error format.
reason: Body parsing is a common requirement for any API. Providing a built‑in, zero‑dependency parser reduces friction for developers, standardizes error handling, and aligns with yantraverse's goal of being a lightweight, production‑ready framework.
